Three-month price momentum of +52.4% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +348% year-on-year, underpinned by a bearish MACD signal suggesting near-term caution is warranted. Composite score of 82/100 places MPC in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +35.8% over the past quarter.
